text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of Mejiro Dober's<n>debut, and Mejiro
Bright, Mejiro<n>Ryan, and Air Groove have all come
to show their support.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to meet the expectations of<n>her loved
ones, Mejiro Dober heads<n>into her debut race
burning with<n>determination!
